st: Keith Eats Everything at Dairy Queen
d: Keith and friends try everything at Dairy Queen!
Escape The Kitchen is back with more chaos than ever before. In this episode, Miles and Kwesi test their skills to Escape The Kitchen.
Vic and Zach battle flying condiments, lava, angry customers, and more to Escape The Kitchen.
Marissa takes us along on her infertility journey.
Marissa has her egg retrieval in the series finale of Marissa In Fertility!

Phoning It In is BACK and BIGGER than ever with a new season of chaos in the kitchen. We kick things off in our first episode with the theme ICE, and trust us when we say they really know how to let it go.
What do cheese wiz and Macarons have in common? Nothing, but leave it to the Try Guys to try and make it work together. Oui Oui, this episode is nothing short of la catastrophe!

Butter up, buttercup! This week's Phoning It In theme is butter, and Keith and Kwesi take things to a whole new level of debauchery. These two go so do-nuts this week, you have to see it to believe it.

Goodness, gracious, great skulls on fire! It's the season FINALE of PHONING IT IN and things get hot in the kitchen, literally! We've got special guest, Shane Madej, from Watcher, and he's ready to take the win from Keith in a head-to-head blazing battle in the kitchen.

st: Ginger Beer Bundt Cake vs Shirley Temple Crepe Cake
d: Keith and Miles go head to head with their chef pairings Mitzi and Monique! Who will win?
